assign.outcome:
**`ext/Panel/Workspace/` built: a class that HOLDS a root, `mount()` grows `$roots[]` for N views of ONE root, documents are files, `/full/` retired.**

![](two-views.png)

- **`Workspace`** (never `extends Panel`) — `workspace(options)` is now `new Workspace(options).$view`, byte-identical for every caller. `mount(root, $root)` in `workspace.js` keys a `WeakMap` by the root object and grows a `Set` of boxes per root, fixing the old "three live mounts share one document — last writer wins" trap: two `mount()` calls on ONE `Workspace` now share one root, one listener pass, one save queue. Proven headless: split in one view, the other gains it too (1→3 panels, both views, in lockstep); a third view added after the fact starts at the current tree, not empty.
- **`documents.js`** — `/data/panels/<name>.json` + `/data/panels/index.json` the Workspace writes itself; `default` stays `/data/panels.json`, zero migration. Proven live: `create("probe-1")`, `create("probe-2")` → index reads `default probe-1 probe-2`; `open("default")` loads the real 9-panel document (matches `/data/panels.json` directly); `remove()` both → back to `["default"]`, `public/data` clean.
- **The Workspace bar** — one row (mode toggle · document name · a slot for task C), `panel-` classes, `@layer theme`. Verified live: clicking `document` sets `root.data.mode`, repaints, and the bar's own "on" state follows.
- **Owner addendum mid-task**: `flow` (wires `flow.js`'s existing `record()`) defaults true only for `mode: document` — verified `fill`→false, `document`→true, explicit override wins. `height`/`center` bounded-space options — verified `--panel-height` on the wrap (not the root box; that was a bug caught and fixed by testing) and `.panel-workspace-center` centering with `var(--wash)`.
- **`/full/` retired** — `route()` + its `full` import + both prose links gone from `page.js`; `readme.md`'s stale mount-trap line and `/full/` link updated, one `Workspace` Use line and one More link added.
- **Four pages unchanged**: `/framework/ext/Panel/`, `/ext/editor/`, `/ext/files/`, `/styles/layouts/space/compose/` — panel/workspace counts identical to a `git stash`-verified before/after (91/9/4/9 panels, 10/2/2/2 workspaces), zero console errors.

**Left, named:** this page isn't in `ext/Panel/page.js`'s `children:` yet (fence allowed only the `/full/` edit there — task C wires the playground nav). The rail's own `mode` picker still duplicates the bar's (design §8 deletes it after task C). `views` (paint.js) keeps only the last-drawn box per item — harmless for every gesture this task proves (all fire `add`, which redraws every box), open for whoever gives it a second dimension.
